title: A1
query: Find all proteins involved in the 'Muscle contraction' pathway.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway {label: 'Muscle contraction'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS ProteinLabel, path.label AS PathwayLabel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway {label: 'Muscle contraction'}) RETURN p.label AS ProteinName, p.id AS ProteinID
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway {name: 'Muscle contraction'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r]->(pathway:Pathway {label: 'Muscle contraction'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.label LIMIT 100

ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (dich:DarkIonChannel)-[r1:hasFamily]->(family:Family {name: 'K'}) WITH dich MATCH (dich)-[r2:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) OPTIONAL MATCH (dich)-[r3:hasGateMechanism]->(gateMech:GateMechanism) RETURN DISTINCT ion.label AS Ion, gateMech.label AS GateMechanism LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (dic:DarkIonChannel)-[r1:hasFamily]->(f:Family {id: 'K'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (dic)-[r2:hasGateMechanism]->(gm:GateMechanism) RETURN DISTINCT dic.label AS dark_ion_channel_label, f.label AS family_label, COLLECT(DISTINCT gm.label) AS gate_mechanisms LIMIT 100

query: Find all functional domains that the protein 'CFTR' shares with other proteins.

title: B5
query: Find all the proteins that are associated with the same pathways and conduct the same ions as the protein 'KCNG3'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p1:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'})-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway) MATCH (p2:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path) WHERE p1 <> p2 OPTIONAL MATCH (p1:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'})-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) OPTIONAL MATCH (p2:Protein)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion) WHERE p1 <> p2 RETURN DISTINCT p2.label AS Protein_Label, path.label AS Pathway_Label, ion.label AS Ion_Label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (kcng3:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'})-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway),       (kcng3)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) WITH p, i MATCH (other:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(p),       (other)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i) WHERE other.label <> 'KCNG3' RETURN DISTINCT other.label AS ProteinName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p1:Protein {name: 'KCNG3'})-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway)<-[:hasPathway]-(p2:Protein) WITH DISTINCT p2, path MATCH (p2)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) WHERE ion IN (     MATCH (p1)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion)     RETURN i ) RETURN DISTINCT p2.name AS protein_name LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p1:Protein {id: 'KCNG3'})-[:involved_in]->(pathway:Pathway)<-[:involved_in]-(p2:Protein) WHERE p1 <> p2 WITH p2, collect(DISTINCT pathway.label) as pathway_labels MATCH (p2)-[:conducts]->(ion:Ion) WITH DISTINCT p2, pathway_labels, collect(DISTINCT ion.label) as ion_labels WHERE all(pathway_label IN pathway_labels WHERE exists((p1)-[:involved_in]->(:Pathway {label: pathway_label})))    AND all(ion_label IN ion_labels WHERE exists((p1)-[:conducts]->(:Ion {label: ion_label}))) RETURN DISTINCT p2.label, pathway_labels, ion_labels LIMIT 100

query: Identify all pathways that connect the dark ion channel 'CACNG3' to diseases through proteins implicated in those diseases.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (dic:DarkIonChannel {id: 'CACNG3'})-[:hasPathway]->(p1:Protein) WITH DIC, p1 MATCH (p1)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d1:Disease) WITH dic, p1, d1 OPTIONAL MATCH (p2:Protein)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d1) WHERE ID(p1) <> ID(p2) AND p2-[:hasPathway]->(p3:Pathway)-[:hasPathway]-(dic) RETURN DISTINCT dic.label AS DarkIonChannelLabel, d1.label AS DiseaseLabel, p3.label AS PathwayLabel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:DarkIonChannel {label: 'CACNG3'})-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d:Disease)-[:implicatedInDisease|interact*1..2]-(p2:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway) RETURN DISTINCT path.label
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (dac:DarkIonChannel {name: 'CACNG3'})-[:hasPathway]->(p1:Protein) WITH DISTINCT p1 MATCH (p1)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d:Disease) MATCH (p2:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway) WHERE p2 = p1 AND d IS NOT NULL RETURN DISTINCT path.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel {id: 'CACNG3'})-[:INTERACTS]->(p1:Protein)-[:IMPLIES_DISEASE]->(di:Disease),       (p2:Pathway)-[:INVOLVES]->(p1) RETURN DISTINCT di.label, p2.label LIMIT 100

query: Find all ion channels that are connected to the 'Neuronal System' pathway through interacting proteins.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (ionChannel:Protein)-[:interact]-(intermediate:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pathway:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) WHERE ionChannel.label CONTAINS 'Ion Channel' RETURN DISTINCT ionChannel.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:interact]->(p2:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pathway:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) WHERE p1.label CONTAINS 'IonChannel' OR p2.label CONTAINS 'IonChannel' RETURN DISTINCT p1, p2
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway {name: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (p)-[:interact]-(ic:IonChannelUnit) RETURN DISTINCT ic.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH path = shortestPath((ic:LightIonChannel)-[:interacts]->(p:Protein)-[:participates_in]-(pw:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'})) RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS LightIonChannel UNION MATCH path = shortestPath((ic:DarkIonChannel)-[:interacts]->(p:Protein)-[:participates_in]-(pw:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'})) RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS DarkIonChannel LIMIT 100

title: C3
query: List the light ion channels in the Chloride channels group and their respective functional domains.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group {label: 'Chloride channels'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (lic)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT lic.label AS LightIonChannel, fd.label AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain),       (lic)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group {label: 'Chloride channels'}) RETURN lic.label AS LightIonChannel, fd.label AS FunctionalDomain
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (lich:LightIonChannel)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain),       (lich)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group {name: "Chloride channels"}) RETURN DISTINCT lich.label AS LightIonChannel, fd.label AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) WHERE g.label = 'Chloride channels' CALL {     WITH lic     MATCH (lic)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain)     RETURN fd.label AS FunctionalDomainLabel } RETURN DISTINCT lic.label AS LightIonChannelLabel, collect(DISTINCT FunctionalDomainLabel) AS FunctionalDomains LIMIT 100

title: C4
query: Which ions are connected to the chemical 'Ozone' through biological processes that involve proteins?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:Chemical {label: 'Ozone'})-[:assoWithBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) MATCH (bp)<-[:hasBiologicalProcess]-(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT i.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (c:Chemical {label: 'Ozone'})-[:assoWithGene]-(p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway) WITH c, p, path MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]-(ion:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT ion.label AS IonName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (c:Chemical {name: 'Ozone'})-[:assoWithGene]->(p:Protein),       (p)-[:hasBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess),       (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT i.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (c:Chemical {id: 'C000499'})-[:asso]->(p:Protein)-[bp:involved_in*1..]->(b:BiologicalProcess)  WITH b, c, p  MATCH (p)-[:contributes_to]->(ion:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT ion.label LIMIT 100
